collection.title: VW Passat CC 2008 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat CC 2008 to 2010 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
